arguments.query: encryption of customer data at rest algorithm

answer:b551e78f-b31a-483d-8ee7-f5c160cad: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:e5dc37b1-b08c-4cb3-9ed8-3631fcc42: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
